title: Architectural Debt Enforcement under Incomplete Observation: A Controlled Study of Ratchets and Evidence Qualification
abstract: arXiv:2610.41276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Architectural debt gates must distinguish an allowed change from an incompletely observed one. We study a decision contract separating observation qualification, prohibited relation identity, inherited debt and authorized baseline updates. Across 240 fixed files from four repositories, the current observer and programmatic reference jointly qualify 166 files (69.17%), all with exact reference-relative edge agreement; 74 remain reference-UNKNOWN. Coverage varies from 13/60 to 59/60 by repository. On 480 constructed state scenarios sharing 60 source anchors, both the candidate ratchet and mature dependency-cruiser baseline match every expected outcome, whereas static and count-only baselines match 420 and 360. These results do not establish candidate superiority. Preserved failures include nine additional false-PASS probes and 120 unqualified full-tree timing attempts. translated_title: 不完全观测下的架构债务执行：棘轮机制与证据资格认定的受控研究
translated_abstract: 架构债务门控必须能够区分允许的变更与观测不完全的变更。我们研究了一种决策契约，将观测资格认定、禁止关系标识、继承债务与授权基线更新相互分离。在来自四个代码库的240个固定文件中，当前观测器与程序化参考共同完成了166个文件（69.17%）的资格认定，且所有认定结果与参考相比的边完全一致；其余74个文件仍处于参考未知状态。各代码库的覆盖率从13/60到59/60不等。在共享60个源锚点的480个构造状态场景中，候选棘轮机制与成熟的依赖巡检基线均匹配了全部预期结果，而静态基线和仅计数基线分别仅匹配420个和360个。这些结果并未确立候选方案的优越性。保留的失败案例包括九个额外的假通过（false-PASS）探针和120次未获资格的全树计时尝试。随后的通用绑定层拒绝了54个指定的不匹配项……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种将观测资格认定、禁止关系标识、继承债务与授权基线更新相互分离的决策契约，用于在不完全观测条件下执行架构债务门控，并通过受控实验表明其候选棘轮机制在480个构造场景中匹配了全部预期结果，同时诚实保留了观测覆盖率限制与失败案例。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision contract that separates observation qualification, prohibited relation identity, inherited debt, and authorized baseline updates for enforcing architectural debt gates under incomplete observation, demonstrating through controlled experiments that its candidate ratchet matches all expected outcomes across 480 constructed scenarios while honestly preserving observer coverage limits and failure cases.
